assumptions: habitual practice HABITUAL-1 continues in every branch (care, arrivals, ordinary decisions)
pressure discharges disabled for all policies
unknown delays sampled from public declared distributions with keyed paired innovations
admissions are not a lever; waiting patients' care counts as uncovered

filter_rules: auto discharge coordination only with observed medical authorization and no open obstacle
target hours from profile, not before readiness estimate, before any planned departure
reinforcement options: known confirmation status and external commitment respected
reinforcement combinations: cumulative loans per lender, skill and hour respected
at most 2 coordinations and 2 reinforcement options per plan
ordering: fewer actions, fewer reinforcement hours, then identifiers; prefix kept when the universe exceeds the bound

reasons: tier1 uncovered_care_minutes: habitual 0.0 -> plan 0.0 (delta 0.0, equivalence tolerance 15.0)
uncertainties: pointwise scenario means; not a simultaneous guarantee over the horizon
synthetic declared distributions; no real-world calibration
